title: Cosine as a Ratio
description: An interactive MicroSim demonstrating how the cosine function can be visualized as the ratio of the adjacent side to the hypotenuse in a right triangle.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Mathematics
Geometry
Trigonometry
learningObjectives: Explain cosine as the ratio of the adjacent side to the hypotenuse in a right triangle
Calculate cos(θ) for a given angle from the displayed adjacent and hypotenuse lengths
Predict whether the cosine value increases or decreases as the angle grows from 0 to 90 degrees
Trace how adjusting the angle reshapes the right triangle and changes the adjacent-to-hypotenuse ratio
